AUTO.description: Reversible, scoped, low-risk operations inside an already authorized task.

operations.operation: Read repository files, Jira issues, Git/GitHub metadata, and public/authorized source documentation.
Run non-destructive status, diff, log, validation, lint, unit-test, and repository-audit commands.
Create or update scoped implementation files on an owned task branch/worktree.
Create focused tests and documentation required by the active task.
Update a Draft PR and meaningful Jira execution metadata for the claimed task when authenticated writes are already authorized.
Move to another independent Ready item after accurately recording a blocker.
Create a short-lived Jira-linked branch/worktree after state reconciliation and claim checks.
Clean generated caches/artifacts that are proven task-owned, ignored, reproducible, and contain no unique work.

AUTO_WITH_GATES.description: Allowed only after stated evidence and safety gates pass.

operations.operation: Commit scoped changes.
Push an owned task branch.
gates: user or session authorization permits push

operations.operation: Create or mark a pull request Ready.
gates: reuse check confirms no existing PR

operations.operation: Merge a pull request under repository policy.
gates: head SHA unchanged since final review

operations.operation: Delete a merged task branch or worktree.
gates: no unique commits or uncommitted files

operations.operation: Add or upgrade a dependency.
Change a non-protected schema/API or architecture boundary.
Publish immutable forecast/model/data artifacts.
Hydrate committed Jira workflow/status/field mappings.
gates: correct BAT site and project verified

operations.operation: Run moderate paid compute or external APIs.

HUMAN_REQUIRED.description: Irreversible, high-risk, authority-sensitive, or financially/security material operations.

operations.operation: Initial publication or reconciliation when local Git history is absent and the remote is empty or has unrelated history.
Force push or rewrite history on main, shared, release, or protected branches.
Discard, delete, reset, clean, or overwrite unknown/unowned/unmerged work.
Weaken, replace, unseal, or tune against protected judging/evaluation/acceptance rules.
Destructive production data/schema migration, irreversible backfill, or deletion of valuable datasets/artifacts.
Change repository visibility, access controls, secrets infrastructure, branch protection, or security policy in a weakening direction.
Approve ambiguous source licensing/redistribution rights or bypass authentication, CAPTCHA, rate limits, or access controls.
Material paid-cloud spend beyond the documented autonomous budget or long-running GPU allocation.
Production release/rollback with external user, cost, data, or availability impact unless a separately approved automated release policy exists.
Delete the canonical repository, recreate it elsewhere, or replace it with a clone/copy as a recovery shortcut.

default_on_ambiguity: Choose the more restrictive class and record the missing gate; do not manufacture approval.
